text: Project LAWA at BINHI is a flagship initiative under the DSWD's Risk Resiliency Program for Climate Change Adaptation and Mitigation (RRP‑CCAM) in the Philippines. It aims to improve resilience against climate- and disaster-related risks such as water scarcity, food insecurity, and environmental degradation. The project focuses on local adaptation strategies and sustainable farming to address water access and nutritious food production in impoverished areas.
